title: A coefficient push mate is invertible exactly when its basis copower comparison is
statement: Let A,B,A′,B′ be categories, N_C : A → B and N_D : A′ → B′ left adjoints with right adjoints R_C and R_D. Let G : A → A′ and G′ : B → B′ be functors, and β : G N_D → N_C G′ a natural transformation, written with Lean's left-to-right composition convention. Suppose R_D reflects isomorphisms and the right mate of β is invertible. Fix M in A and an indexing type I, with the I-copowers of M and G(M) existing. For each i let e_i be an endomorphism of N_C(M) and e′_i an endomorphism of N_D(G(M)), satisfying e′_i ≫ β_M = β_M ≫ G′(e_i). Assume that the morphisms from the respective copowers with components unit_C,M ≫ R_C(e_i) and unit_D,G(M) ≫ R_D(e′_i) are invertible. Then β_M is invertible if and only if the canonical comparison from the I-copower of G(M) to G of the I-copower of M is invertible. No finiteness, additivity or preservation of coproducts is assumed.

source.place: BaseChange section, isIso_mateEquiv_app_of_isIso_biproductDesc, generalized from finite biproducts to arbitrary copowers with the comparison explicit

proof.text: Let β′ be the invertible right mate. Apply the unit-mate identity to M. Check on every coprojection that the target basis morphism followed by R_D(β_M) equals the canonical copower comparison followed by G of the source basis morphism and β′ at N_C(M). Compatibility of e_i with β_M and naturality of β′ give the component equality.

The image under G of the source basis morphism and the component of β′ are invertible. Both basis morphisms are invertible by hypothesis. Cancelling these factors in the equality shows that R_D(β_M) is invertible exactly when the copower comparison is. Reflection of isomorphisms by R_D gives the equivalence. The same calculation covers the empty indexing type whenever the stipulated isomorphisms exist.

proof_origin.place: Fully proved unit-mate calculation, generalizing the existing finite-basis proof
